title: DEEP LEARNING AND ETHICS
findings: The paper identifies 'religion' as an example of an unobservable feature of marginalized communities, making bias mitigation challenging. It also cites research suggesting that 'religious views' can be predicted from social media 'likes' and used for manipulative purposes.
